AUDACY appears as a logo under 'Atlanta United Team Partners', but its role is not described. The app page mentions only 'broadcast info'. Spanish site es.atlutd.com could not be reached.

austinfc.com/club/corporate-partners lists 'Broadcast Partners': iHeart Radio (links to iheartmedia.com Austin stations) and Univision (univision.com/local/austin-kakw). The page gives no call letters, frequency or language for the radio partner, so no station is listed. The page is undated. The /espanol, /fans/matchday and /schedule pages have no radio info.

league_audio.name: Apple TV (MLS)
league_audio.what: MLS press release dated 11/13/2025: in 2026 all MLS matches stream on Apple TV for subscribers at no extra cost, and the standalone MLS Season Pass ends after 2025. The release does NOT mention radio, local radio calls, home/away audio or language feeds, so the audio-option claim is UNVERIFIED.
